name: Final recipe: enriched teacher ensembles, dense multi-view distillation and quantization-aware training
authorization: Latest user explicitly authorizes +English Smart Turn and +AppTek, excludes AMI/ICSI, and launch after readiness; exploratory audit limitations retained.

data.training_cloud_sources: Only explicitly allowlisted public training audio and associated manifests; no Krisp, otoSpeech or TurnBench.
data.dense: Derived causal prefixes from existing training groups only; 100ms grid in eligible pause regions, deterministic stratified sample capped16384per student epoch including eligible HOLD pauses without original rows. No hard labels invented; raw grid is not all scored.
data.dense_eligibility: Train groups only, causal client-speech prefix; exclude technical, low_confidence (VAD confidence), overlap_at_pause, no_speech_before and customer_backchannel; truncate at agent onset. No hard labels assigned to retained dense points.
data.dense_historical_count_note: The original L0321.4M and L009654 were estimates/audits of different universes; record actual final eligibility counts without equating them.
data.split_policy: Explicit frozen r3 dev; never regroup expanded manifests

teacher.architecture: Cohere Transcribe C2 LoRA r16 alpha32 dropout0.05
teacher.optimizer: new AdamW, FP32 master weights and moments; not exact resume of old Adam
teacher.precision: BF16 eager autocast; IEEE FP32 for ensemble cache unless separately validated
teacher.views: L037 A1 pinned augmentation, telephony0.3 and room tone; epoch1
teacher.checkpoint: final fixed budget, preserve per-step resume checkpoints
teacher.ensemble: arithmetic mean of three raw logits, then temperature2; never average LoRA factors
teacher.cache: same causal realized waveform for all teachers and student; FP32 accumulation, storageFP32; key binds parent/ensemble/model/code/manifest/row/cut/view seed/epoch/waveform SHA
teacher.pos_weight: Preserve each original parent cfg pos_weight; new data do not change the parent loss ratio

student.loss: pure temperature2 Bernoulli KL, unchanged original row weights, no class posweight or hard BCE; dense row weight1
student.precision: BF16 eager and FP32 master AdamW, no activation checkpointing
student.cache_epoch3: 32768 fixed train views for1024 matched updates per branch, batch32 preserved
student.checkpoint: final fixed budget plus last-three predetermined trajectory snapshots; no benchmark-driven early stopping
student.learning_rate_selection: Same full two-pass budget and seed111 for three LRs; highest fixed-dev AUC, then lowest weighted hard BCE, then lower LR. No public/Krisp selection. Preserve candidates and numerical failures; infrastructure errors halt.

ensembles_and_soups.existing_B11_ensemble: mean of raw logits from all three existing students; no repeated training; quality and full API latency reported as three-forward model
ensembles_and_soups.existing_B11_soup: average corresponding full floating model weights, retain nonfloating buffers only if identical; require same configuration and keys; diagnostic on training dev before any downstream use
ensembles_and_soups.trajectory_soup: average three predeclared late snapshots from the same new student trajectory, equal weights
ensembles_and_soups.selection: For final-vs-trajectory-soup, choose soup only if fixed training-dev AUC is at least final and BCE no worse; otherwise choose final. Existing-seed soup is separate diagnostic. Never use Krisp/public benchmark to select this.

quantization.init: identical selected new student checkpoint for matchedFP andQAT branches
quantization.control: same Linear FP32 wrappers, arithmetic precision, init, data order, teacher targets and optimizer budget; fake quant disabled only inFP branch
quantization.target: encoder Linear activationUINT8 per tensor and weightINT8 symmetric per output channel, input/output fake quant as required by actual ORT kernels; Conv/LayerNorm/softmax/head remain floating
quantization.observers: Observe first512 updates, freeze final512; preserve original matched fine-tuning budget independently of main-training batch
quantization.serving: exportQDQONNX, require actual integer kernels inORT profile and checkpoint/export parity; fakequant Torch timing is not deployedINT8 timing
quantization.comparison: quality differences and actual fullHTTP latency/throughput/model size; preserve both outputs regardless of pass/fail

evaluation.public: official harness unchanged; heldout accents, L007 and internal frontier; compare current baseline and historical results with clear protocol context
evaluation.krisp: host evaluation only for L041; two firing rules, G3 harness; no training, threshold tuning for training, clips/IDs/audio upload
evaluation.quantization_quality: same items, paired by official turn or Krisp speaker,1000bootstrap. Report fixedFP policy and independently refitted policies distinctly; no claim of blind confirmation on reused benchmarks
evaluation.cpu_http: same host,4threads,400requests each c1/4/8,0error accounting,flock hostquiet and no competing scientific workloads; matchedFPONNXvsQATINT8
evaluation.gpu_http: full Cohere HTTP in the rentedH200 with hardware/backend/precision/concurrency explicit; encoder-forward latency alone not accepted
evaluation.limitations: one new student seed, adaptive combined recipe and reused dev/test; individual contributions other than matchedQAT cannot be attributed; no SOTA or production-ready claim

operations.selection: H200 provisional total-cost choice: B200 requires>2x overall speed at quoted rates; no measured2x evidence for our mixed pipeline. Include transfer and initialization, not nominal FLOPS.
operations.host_guard: budget/progress supervision and repeated artifact collection; stop early if work complete; reserve recovery time before provider termination
operations.budget_policy: Do not rent before verified public bundle and local QAT/teacher smoke readiness. Measure GPU throughput on bounded train-only pilot before full queue; record any reduced update budget before scientific stages. QAT and matched measurements mandatory. Do not silently drop work or exceed20USD.
operations.secrets: Lium API key host env only; no key in payload files, logs, models, image, git or W&B
operations.tracking: aggregated W&B metrics only; no audio/predictions/IDs
operations.pre_scientific_pilot: Measure train-only throughput before full queue; do not begin if conservative remaining total plus recovery exceeds the $20 deadline. Any lower fixed budget must be registered before training, never chosen from evaluation quality.

batch_selection.rule: Smallest batch within5% fastest, require>=10% gain over32 and<=126GiB memory; long train-only disposable pilot
batch_selection.learning_rates: Teacher and matched FP/QAT unchanged; main student compares 2e-5, 8e-5, 3.2e-4 on fixed dev only. Throughput evidence does not establish quality.
batch_selection.exposure: Preserve all teacher/student passes; keep matched continuation batch32/1024updates and32768examples
batch_selection.feature_cache: FP32 mel computed from full normalized8s view during teacher scoring; cache exact trailing400frames. Target/wave/feature SHA checks and source identity. No lossy storage or frontend change.
batch_selection.limitation: Timing proxy uses repeated1280 train views and constant student KD targets; validate sustained training throughput. Batch choice is not proof of quality optimum.
